name: ghost
description: Verified control of the whole desktop for agents and programs on Windows and Linux: apps with no API, windows, shell, browser.
long_description:
Ghost gives an agent or a program the operating system's own control surface: the apps with no API, the windows, the shell, and the browser you are already logged into, in the background without taking your screen or cursor, with every action verified. It drives real controls through UI Automation and posted window messages, launches apps on hidden desktops, runs commands and persistent PowerShell sessions, drives Chromium-family browsers through the DevTools protocol, reads text out of apps with no export, and turns "did it work" into a machine check.

The model driving Ghost does any looking that is needed, via ghost_see (every element with name, role and centre) or ghost_screenshot, so no vision API key is required. This bundle contains the ghost-mcp server binary for one platform; the CLI, HTTP server, source and Linux setup notes are on the releases page.

vision_api_key.title: Vision API key for the optional built-in tier (not needed for agents)
vision_api_key.description: Leave empty. The model driving Ghost reads ghost_see and ghost_screenshot itself. This key only enables Ghost's optional built-in vision tier for description targets such as "the blue Submit button" (any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint).
